title_zh: 随着筹码反弹、中东紧张局势缓和，华尔街高开

title: Marvell stock surges on S&P 500 inclusion
title_zh: Marvell 股价因纳入标准普尔 500 指数而飙升
summary: Marvell shares jumped 9% in premarket on news of plans to include the chipmaker in the S&P 500 index.
summary_zh: 由于计划将芯片制造商纳入标准普尔 500 指数的消息传出，Marvell 股价在盘前上涨了 9%。

title: Tech stocks today: Chip stocks rebound after Nvidia's Jensen Huang says investors should be 'very happy'
title_zh: 今日科技股：英伟达 (Nvidia) 黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 表示投资者应该“非常高兴”后，芯片股反弹
summary: Tech stocks are recovering from a brusing sell-off ahead of Oracle earnings, Apple's Worldwide Developers Conference, and the highly anticipated SpaceX IPO.
summary_zh: 在甲骨文财报、苹果全球开发者大会以及备受期待的 SpaceX 首次公开募股之前，科技股正在从惨烈的抛售中恢复过来。

title: SpaceX is being 'rushed' into the public market, strategist says
title_zh: 战略师称 SpaceX 正在“匆忙”进入公开市场
summary: Humilis Investment Strategies chief investment officer and CEO Brian Belski chats with Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman about why he won't be buying SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) when it goes public.
summary_zh: Humilis Investment Strategies 首席投资官兼首席执行官 Brian Belski 与雅虎财经的 Julie Hyman 讨论了为什么他不会在 SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 上市时购买它。

title: Analysis-Nvidia's AI PC push banks on unproven demand beyond niche users
title_zh: 分析-Nvidia的AI PC推动银行超越利基用户的未经证实的需求
summary: Nvidia's entry into the AI PC market with its RTX Spark superchip last week is less a breakthrough for regular users than a high-stakes bet that a largely unproven concept can find wider appeal, ‌analysts said.
summary_zh: 分析师表示，英伟达上周凭借 RTX Spark 超级芯片进入 AI PC 市场，这对于普通用户来说并不是一个突破，而是一个高风险的赌注，即一个基本上未经证实的概念可以找到更广泛的吸引力。

title: UK competition watchdog launches probe into eBay's purchase of Depop
title_zh: 英国竞争监管机构对 eBay 收购 Depop 展开调查
summary: The UK competition regulator on ‌Monday launched a ‌probe into eBay's $1.2 billion purchase ​of Gen Z-focused fashion resale platform Depop from Etsy.
summary_zh: 英国竞争监管机构周一对 eBay 以 12 亿美元从 Etsy 收购专注于 Z 世代的时尚转售平台 Depop 的交易展开调查。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures mixed as oil rises after Iran and Israel exchange strikes
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货涨跌互现，伊朗和以色列交易所罢工后油价上涨
summary: US stock futures were mixed as concerns about a Middle East ceasefire continued to weigh, and investors braced for fresh inflation data and a blockbuster SpaceX IPO this week.
summary_zh: 由于对中东停火的担忧持续发酵，美国股指期货涨跌互现，投资者为本周新的通胀数据和 SpaceX IPO 做好准备。

title: Panasonic to start US data centre battery production by fiscal 2028
title_zh: 松下将于 2028 财年开始在美国数据中心生产电池
summary: Panasonic Holdings said on Monday it plans to ‌start mass production of battery ‌cells for data centre applications at a plant ​in the U.S. state of Kansas in the financial year 2028, which ends March 2029.
summary_zh: 松下控股周一表示，计划在 2028 财年（截至 2029 年 3 月）在美国堪萨斯州的一家工厂开始大规模生产用于数据中心应用的电池。

title: Apple WWDC preview: Apple gets a second shot at its AI rollout
title_zh: 苹果 WWDC 预览：苹果再次推出人工智能
summary: Apple will hold its WWDC event on Monday, June 8.
summary_zh: Apple 将于 6 月 8 日星期一举办 WWDC 活动。
